post.description:
Upload a representation's bytes with its metadata, as multipart/form-data. The gateway forwards the upload untouched to the Archivist, which holds the knowledge base's tree: it stores the bytes and records the resource — as a clone of the token's source when the upload carries `cloneToken` — for the caller the gateway verified, and the new resource's id comes back with 202. What follows from the resource's creation — graph, views, vectors — settles afterwards, announced by `yield:created` on the bus.

Bytes travel on this HTTP request, never on the bus.

format.description: Media type of the content (e.g. text/plain, text/markdown, image/png)

storageUri.description: Where the content lives (file://... for local). Required — the client names the location; the server does not derive one.

entityTypes.description: JSON-stringified array of entity type names

sourceAnnotationId.description: For AI-generated resources: the annotation that triggered generation. Nested into generatedFrom.annotationId on the persisted event.

sourceResourceId.description: For AI-generated resources: the source resource the generating annotation lives on. Nested into generatedFrom.resourceId on the persisted event.

generationPrompt.description: For AI-generated resources: the prompt that drove generation

generator.description: For AI-generated resources: JSON-stringified Agent naming the model/worker that produced the content. Its identity must be the uploading agent's own — the knowledge base refuses a generator naming anyone else. `creator` and `wasAttributedTo` are never sent; the knowledge base derives them from the cited job.

jobId.description: The job this resource fulfils, when a worker is creating it. Forwarded onto yield:create; the knowledge base derives who requested the resource from the cited job's own events, and refuses a worker-role create that cites none. Absent for a person's own upload.

isDraft.description: 'true' or 'false' — whether the resource is a draft

cloneToken.description: A clone token from `yield:clone-token-requested`. With it, the resource is created as a clone of the token's source, inheriting its entity types; `language`, `entityTypes` and the generation fields are then not read.

archiveOriginal.description: With `cloneToken`: 'true' archives the source once the clone exists.

400.description: The upload is not multipart/form-data; a required field is missing (name, file, format, storageUri); the format's base media type is not a SupportedMediaType; or `entityTypes` or `generator` is not what it must be. The message names what is wrong.

500.description: The knowledge base refused to record the resource; the message says why.
